testcase.name: Scenario: Inspect and cancels conditional feature suppression: tmp/oblikovati-ribbon-relocated.RcZVDl/model-browser-published-snapshot/checkout/features/application/model-browser/model-browser.feature:678:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Inspect and cancels conditional feature suppression ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open in the MCAD Software ✔ And an unsuppressed extrusion is selected in the MCAD Software model browser ✔ When the user chooses Properties from the extrusion context menu ✔ Then Feature Properties shows the feature name and Suppress, Adaptive and Feature Appearance controls ✔ And Always and If are unchecked ✔ And the conditional suppression controls are disabled ✔ When the user checks If ✔ Then the parameter selector, comparison operator and value field are enabled ✔ And OK is disabled while the comparison value is empty ✔ When the user opens the comparison operator list ✔ Then it offers equals, not equals, less than, less than or equal, greater than and greater than or equal ✔ When the user chooses greater than or equal ✔ Then that operator is displayed ✔ When the user clicks Cancel and reopens Feature Properties ✔ Then If is unchecked and the conditional controls are disabled ✔ When the user clicks Cancel ✔ Then the dialog closes and the solid remains visible
